$comment: HUMI SIT new-hire key-in form. Every selector here resolved against the live page on 2026-09-18 (run hrsit-jev-direct-20260918170710); a selector that has never resolved does not belong in this file. Sheet field names are matched case-insensitively after stripping punctuation. Employee ID is not a form field: it exists only after Submit, on the profile, and the DB evidence carries it.

province.$note: The list renders English ('— Select Province —', options 'Bangkok'). Thai matched via the search box in the 11:25 run but not once the form was filled deterministically; English is what the page shows.

postal code.$note: Once a Sub-District is chosen the code fills itself and the control is a read-only TEXTBOX, not the button the empty state shows (healer proposal on every pass-3 case, 2026-09-21).

holiday calendar.$note: Control read from humi-SIT source 2026-09-21 (label via htmlFor; the asterisk span is aria-hidden); unverified live until the first run that reaches it. Options '<code> - <name>'.

Empty until an Employee Group is chosen; options '<code> - <name>'. A sheet writes '10 ตามชุดข้อมูล' — only the leading code is the value.

pay group.$note: 238 options labelled like CDH:MJT:01-31:EOM16D; the DB code (ES) is not the label. Verified present 2026-09-21.

Server-searched: the first list holds 20 rows, the rest arrive 300 ms after typing; options read '<code> - <name>', so the sheet's code matches by prefix. Choosing it fills Organization, Cost Center, Division, Business Unit, HR District, Work Location, Zone, SSO Location from employee_foundation.positions.

email.why: Contact requires at least one valid email; the sheet states none

employee sub group.why: page 2 requires a Sub-Group valid for the chosen group; the first row of view_employee_group_mappings for that group

contract type.why: Contract Type is required; groups A/B/C get R1 from the app, and C3 on H/E/G hides Contract End Date

contract end date.why: only group D still shows a required Contract End Date; one year after the hire date

supervisor id.why: Direct Manager is required and no longer derived from the Position; an active C001 employee in department 30042174 (SIT, read 2026-09-21)

original start date.why: required and not defaulted by the UI; the hire date

seniority date.why: required and not defaulted by the UI; the hire date

time status.why: required; the app's auto-derive never fires. 01 - Clocking is what the sheet's Expected names

amount.why: Base Salary must be greater than 0; the sheet states none

bank.why: Compensation requires a Bank; the sheet states none. A real row of master_banks

account number.why: Compensation requires an Account Number; the sheet states none

payment method.why: Compensation requires a Payment Method; the sheet states none. A real row of master_payment_methods

$requiredViaAgent.$comment: Empty since 2026-09-21: Phone Number and Email have observed selectors and are entered as verified steps.

$identityGate.why: the form reveals the Address section only once Identity is complete; the run that reached the address (2026-09-18 11:25) asserted this first

$advance.$comment: After pressing an advance control the page must no longer show the marker that proved the old page, and no dialog may be open. A press that merely succeeded mechanically is not an advance: on 2026-09-21 Next 'passed' in 526 ms while a validation modal listed Company, Date of Birth and an identity format error, and the flow carried on as if it were on page 2.
$advance.$submitNote: The control is labelled 'Save & Submit' (healed from 'Submit' at 11.8 s on 2026-09-21).

$appDerived.$comment: Fields the sheet lists as Test Data that the APPLICATION fills and renders read-only. Evidence: humi-SIT StepJob.tsx renders Business Unit `disabled readOnly` and sets it from the chosen Position (setBusinessUnit(posData.businessUnitCode)); a leg told to set it answered BLOCKED at p=0.68, correctly. Never typed; the report records them as derived. Department likewise: StepJob.tsx has no Department input — setOrganization(posData.departmentCode) fills a read-only Organization box from the Position (positions.department_code 30042174 for 40106337, verified 2026-09-21). Division, Cost Center, Work Location, SSO Location, Zone, HR District and Store/Branch are set by the same Position onChange (StepJob.tsx safeSet calls; seen filled live as 1733 / T153 on 2026-09-21); Frequency and Currency are disabled read-only inputs the app fills (StepCompensation.tsx: 'MON', THB).

$afterAdvance.$comment: Step 2 opens with every section but Position collapsed; a collapsed section keeps its controls hidden and never fetches its options (ClusterJob.tsx, CollapsibleSectionCard.tsx), so every dropdown below is empty until this is pressed.
